Dialogs.Dialog: Aren't you making a lecherous face？
Hey, aren't you staring a bit... too much？
If something's on your mind, tell me？
I feel like I can sleep well tonight...
Hehe. Can I pat you too？
It's not like I'm lonely or anything...
I wish I could stop time...
Your hands really do feel nice.
Your hands are gentle... I like them, you know？
Shall we just run off somewhere like this？ Just kidding.
Yes. Just a little more, like this...
What do I do？ I don't want to be apart...
I want to stay like this longer...
I don't want to let go...
This kind of thing may not be bad.
This feeling is nice, isn't it.
I've never felt like this before...
I'm glad to be with you.
Geez... Not fair, it's always you.
Hehe, I love you... I'm kidding.
I like it when you do that, you know？
It's fun... I'll let you have that one.
I wonder why, I just can't stop laughing.
Is it okay to have this much fun？
I wish moments like this could last forever.
You're doing it on purpose, aren't you？ ...Geez.
...It's your fault that my face is red.
Only you get to do this, okay？
I'll do the same thing to you, okay？
I want to do this forever...
Hehe, stay with me like this okay？
Having you all to myself... Just kidding.
I don't hate it, you know？ That kind of thing.
Is it okay if I want more？
As long as it's only me, it's fine, though？
Keep watching me like that, okay？ Only me.
Hehe, I love you... I'm kidding.
Only you get to do this, okay？
Hehe... It's a bit embarrassing, isn't it？
...It's your fault I'm blushing like this.
I work hard at taking care of my hair.
...It makes me want to be pampered.
I kind of like it when you do this.
When you stroke me, I get sleepy.
Can I do the same to you？
I shouldn't have any bedhead, though...
Hehe, are you trying to make static？
Make sure you fix it later. Just kidding.
I feel like a dog or a cat.
Hiding that you're shy？ Hehe, cute▼
I don't think I have a fever...
How I feel？ I'm not sick, you know？
Only the spot you touched feels like it's getting hot.
That's not enough to surprise me.
No, that's off-limits. It makes me go weak.
Mm！ Geez, none of that. Okay？
This is nice too, right？ Hehe.
Can I get a little closer？
Hehe, maybe I'll lean on you？
You can't do this with other girls, okay？
Holding hands with you makes me feel safe...
Can we hold hands with our fingers laced？ Just kidding.
G-Geez... why are you coming so close？
If you come this close, I'll get self-conscious...
...What are you planning to do coming so close？
Aren't you still a little far？ Just kidding...
Even if we're close... I don't really mind...
Yeah... we're lovers, after all, right？
This distance is a privilege just for me, right？
You can do whatever you like...
One more time... Is that not okay...？
What are you going to do with me？
...Why do I end up like this？
Don't look at me so much...？
...It's not fair that it's always me.
I'm embarrassed... look the other way？
I'm happy... I am happy, but...？
Why not just do as you like？
You like that, don't you？ That...
...Hehe, what were you trying to do？
Hehe, I won't forgive you, okay？
What do you want to do？ Geez...
Um, you're putting me on the spot...
Did you get sick of it...？
I wonder if I did something to bother you...
It's a little far, I think... Just kidding...
We can close the distance, right？
I want to feel you more...
I don't want to be even one millimeter apart...
Just a little more is all I want, though？
I don't want it to end like this...
Hey, one more time... Is it okay？
Shall we do it one more time...？
You won't say you're stopping, right...？
What do I do, it's not enough...
I want to know more about you...
I want to touch you more...
I want to stay this way, forever...
It seems it's still not enough...
...I'm waiting, you know？ For a kiss.
I want to kiss you... just kidding...
And I worked up my courage...
Geez, and I was looking forward to it...
So you're not doing anything... No, never mind！
Can't even solve a problem like this？ What a naughty boy...
I have to punish a bad boy who's forgotten his homework...
You won't listen to your teacher？
Such a short skirt... Oh, Master...
Welcome home, Master. Will you have dinner？ Just kidding...
After you eat, there is a delicious dessert for you, Master...
I have to give my Master a massage before going to bed...
I'd like dessert after the meal too...
If I eat this much, my weight... but...
Being late... It's not a good thing... Umm...
I have to do my best in club activities...
Studying ahead and reviewing, I have to do it properly...
I can see your face really well.
When you look at me that much... It's okay, though.
Ah... No, I don't mean I don't like it.
Hey, what do you want to do？
Hehe, I've been waiting for this▼
Just a little... No, it's okay.
Yes. I want you to... come closer.
It's not weird for a girl to ask, right...
I'm going to... ask for something.
I want you to pamper me.
Don't you like this kind of thing？
Is it sunny outside, I wonder...
Waking up to his kiss... Just kidding... Hehe.
I don't want to get out of the futon...
I got to see him even in my dream... Hehe.
Just a little longer is okay, right...
Huh, where is he...？ ...Oh, he's at his house...
